The vendor directly providing **OptinMonster** at **optinmonster.com** is **Retyp, LLC** (doing business as OptinMonster).

### Evidence
* **Terms of Service:** *"These Terms of Service (the “Agreement”) set forth the terms and conditions that apply to your access and use of the internet website owned and operated by Retyp, LLC d/b/a OptinMonster (“Retyp”) and located at optinmonster, app.optinmonster.com and \*.optinmonster.com (the “Site”) ... and access and use of the services available thereon..."*
* **Privacy Policy:** *"Retyp LLC (“Retyp”) operates several websites including optinmonster.com."*
